senses.example: El encierro de San Fermín es en julio.
senses.exampleGloss: The running of the bulls at San Fermín is in July.

alternatives.reason: The afternoon bullfight, not the morning run; related festival but different event.
The whole festival week, of which the encierro is one event.
The noon start of San Fermín; a different single moment.

notes: Highly local to Pamplona; encierro also means confinement in general, but only the San Fermín sense is taught.
